newsitem.title: USA: Optical Cable Oct sales rise to $5.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Optical Cable Oct sales rise to $5.5 mln.

text.p: Optical Cable Corp said on Wednesday its sales for the month of October were $5.5 million versus $3.1 million in the same month last year, an increase of 77 percent.
Order input for October 1996 was $5.11 million, against $3.7 million for the same month last year, Optical said.
The company said both sales and order input for October 1996 represented new record monthly highs.
